transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. What brings you here today?

Hi, thank you so much for seeing me. Um... I hope I'm in the right place for this. 

I guess I'm here because I've been having a little trouble with... well, with my eating lately. It's probably not a huge deal compared to what you usually see, but... after I have these, um, eating episodes, I just feel really gross and disappointed in myself. I feel like I should have way more control over myself, you know? It's a little embarrassing to admit, but I get so upset that I end up writing some pretty awful things about myself in my journal. 

Does that make sense? I just want to make sure I'm explaining it okay.
After these eating episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit, use laxatives, or do anything else to try to 'undo' the food you've eaten?

Oh, no... no, I definitely don't do that. I've never made myself throw up or taken laxatives or anything like that. I just... I just kind of sit with the awful feeling afterwards, you know? 

I hope that's a good thing, that I don't do that? I mean, I know some people do, but I just try to tell myself I'll be better the next day and leave it at that. Did I answer that right? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Do these eating episodes cause you a lot of distress, or do they interfere with your daily life in any way?

Um, well... I don't think it interferes too much. Like, I always make sure I still get to my cleaning shifts on time, and I still go to my design events. I try really hard to be responsible about all that, so I don't let it stop me from doing what I need to do. 

But... I guess, if I'm being completely honest, the next day I do feel pretty distracted. And just... really ashamed of myself. Um... sometimes I even put off my sketching, which I usually love doing. I just... I avoid it because I really don't want to open my book and see those awful journal entries I mentioned writing about myself the night before. 

I hope that makes sense? I mean, I'm still functioning and going to work, so I hope it doesn't sound like I'm completely falling apart. I really am trying to keep it together. Did I explain that okay?
During these eating episodes, do you ever feel like you can't stop eating or control what or how much you're eating?

Um... well, yes. I guess that's... that's probably the most embarrassing part for me to admit. 

It's not like I completely lose my mind or anything, but... once I start, it just feels like I keep reaching for the next thing almost automatically. Like, even while I'm sitting there thinking to myself, 'Fumi, stop, you have sketches to finish,' I... I just don't actually stop. I usually just keep going until the food is gone, or... or I feel too uncomfortable to eat anymore. 

I really hope that doesn't make me sound completely out of control... I mean, I do try to stop, I really do. Am I answering your question right? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need to know.
